about_the_game:
THE GAME

Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos is a Lovecraftian point-and-click graphic adventure that plunges you into the depths of cosmic horror. Set in 500 AD Oman, this third installment of our saga draws inspiration from H.P. Lovecraft's most enigmatic stories such as "The Nameless City" and "Nyarlathotep", taking you on a thrilling investigation that will test the limits of your sanity.

You'll step into the role of Rabian, a brilliant but introverted scholar from the Library of Athens, forced to return to his hometown of Kabar. What begins as a reluctant homecoming soon spirals into a nightmarish journey, as Rabian becomes entangled in the machinations of an ancient cult worshipping forgotten deities.

Ancient powers stir beneath the sands. Forbidden knowledge awaits. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?


GAMEPLAY FEATURES

• A mature, atmospheric point-and-click adventure from the creators of the Chronicle of Innsmouth saga.

• A story that blends ancient mystery with cosmic horror, set in a rarely explored historical era.

• Enhanced retro art style with higher resolution, richly detailed environments, and hand-crafted pixel art.

• Full professional English voice acting for all main and supporting characters.

• An atmospheric original soundtrack featuring period-inspired instruments, evoking forbidden knowledge, cosmic insignificance, and the fragile veil between sanity and madness.

• Diverse locations, from the scholarly halls of Athens to a meticulously recreated ancient village of Kabar, and the mysterious temples of forgotten deities.

• Challenging yet logical puzzles that test your deduction and problem-solving skills, intertwined with cryptic texts and arcane symbols, steeped in Lovecraftian mystery.

linux_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or superior
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA/AMD with updated drivers
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
